instruction: Delete all .jpg files from my file system ~/downloads folder.
notes: Single-app task (file_system). The agent must list ~/downloads (show_directory with substring '.jpg' filter) to discover the .jpg file paths, then delete each with delete_file. The set of .jpg files is unknown a priori, so it is modeled as a fixed set of placeholder filepath objects (two here, matching the reference solution's call count); the actual number of delete_file steps equals the number of .jpg entries returned by show_directory. The app constant is spelled file-system (hyphenated) per PDDL naming. supervisor-complete-task takes the deleted file records (non-API parameters) so its precondition equals the goal conjunction; it has no answer parameter since the task asks no question. Non-jpg files must not be deleted, which the is-jpg precondition enforces.
